name: SNeRF
aliases: Neural Radiance Fields for Street Views
definition: A NeRF design for novel view synthesis of large-scale background scenes and foreground moving vehicles jointly, using noisy and sparse LiDAR points for robust geometry learning and reprojection-based confidence to address depth outliers.
summary: SNeRF is a neural radiance field method for novel view synthesis in large-scale street views that jointly reconstructs static backgrounds and moving vehicles using sparse LiDAR and minimal camera overlap.
